bio: For starters, the location right on the square known by locals as Stachus is nothing short of exclusive. GRETA OTO is housed within the luxurious and contemporary new Königshof hotel, on the ninth floor to be precise, affording fantastic views of the city of Munich and the Frauenkirche. The restaurant is no less chic and sophisticated than the hotel itself. Calm warm hues and dimmed lighting create an intimate atmosphere. The cuisine is Latin American with modern international influences, from Peruvian ceviche to Brazilian fillet steak and grilled octopus. The wine list to accompany the food is international. Tip: They have a private table – La Mesa – that you can book for special occasions. There is also a bar and a lounge terrace....
